description: Curated fixed game text and authored variants. Native RGB/styles are retained from selected static game examples or existing public tests. No raw shared log, player name, roster, personal progress, dates, account ID or API/cache data is included. This is a regression cohort, not an estimate of whole-game coverage.
intentPolicy: TRANSLATE fixes the denominator before parsing. PRESERVE is intentional English names/stats/rarities/blank lines. UNREVIEWED is never silently exempted. Weights are authored repetitions for frequency aggregation, not render-frame counts.
